posts.title: Chase the Sun 2026
posts.description: It’s 207 miles to Weston-super-Mare , I’ve got full bottles of water, half a box of rice cakes, it’s sunrise, and I’m wearing sunglasses. Hit it. What? Chase the Sun is a yearly set of rides that attempt to cross the width of various countries between sunrise and sunset on the longest day of the year.
